name: dentpilot-university-production-core
description: Production-grade modular monolith foundation for DentPilot University.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @dentpilot/contracts && npm run build --workspace @dentpilot/domain && npm run build --workspace @dentpilot/config && npm run build --workspace @dentpilot/api && npm run build --workspace @dentpilot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @dentpilot/contracts && npm run build --workspace @dentpilot/domain && npm run build --workspace @dentpilot/config && npm run typecheck --workspace @dentpilot/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @dentpilot/web
scripts.lint: npm run build:packages && npm run lint --workspace @dentpilot/api && npm run lint --workspace @dentpilot/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @dentpilot/contracts && npm run build --workspace @dentpilot/domain && npm run build --workspace @dentpilot/config
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:packages && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/integration
scripts.test:migration: npm run build:packages && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/integration/clean-migration.test.ts
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
